newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse closed Sunday due to member's death.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse closed Sunday due to member's death.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) will remain closed on Sunday because of the death of one of its members, an exchange official said on Saturday.
He said the KSE, which closed for the Friday-Saturday weekend, would reopen on Monday.

KSE's 100 share price index closed 3.15 points, or 0.23 percent, higher on the last trading session on Tuesday amid 146 losers and 97 gainers in a turnover of 24 million shares, up from Monday's 22 million.
